Key Responsibilities:

You will own the end-to-end delivery of new payment products, specifically focusing on UPI and alternative digital payment methods.

1) Product Incubation: Ideate and conceptualize new payment features from scratch, including UPI Autopay, Credit on UPI, and multi-bank settlement engines.

2) Hands-on Development: This is a "maker" role. You will personally draft detailed PRDs, create wireframes, map out API sequences, and define logic for edge-case handlings.

3) Technical Ownership: Work deeply with engineering teams to oversee the architecture, ensuring high success rates and low latency for millions of concurrent transactions.

4) Regulatory Alignment: Stay ahead of NPCI, RBI, and international regulatory shifts to ensure our UPI stack is both innovative and compliant.

5) Stakeholder Orchestration: Act as the central nervous system between Engineering, Sales, Risk, and Compliance to move the product from alpha testing to a full-scale commercial launch.

Requirements:

1) Direct Build Experience: You must have a track record of launching at least one major fintech product from scratch. You should be able to describe the "v1.0" hurdles you personally cleared.

2) Payment Domain Mastery: 3-6 years in Product Management with deep expertise in the Indian Payment Ecosystem (UPI stack, IMPS, BBPS) and digital wallets.

3) Technical Literacy: You are comfortable reading API documentation, understanding database schemas, and discussing system architecture with senior engineers.

4) Data-Driven Mindset: Proven ability to use SQL, Mixpanel, or similar tools to analyze transaction funnels and identify drop-off points.

5) Entrepreneurial Grit: You thrive in ambiguity and are comfortable taking "extreme ownership" of a product's success or failure.

description_snippet:
A payment gateway that actually works the same whether you're checking out on a website, tapping a Soundbox, or charging your EV. Nobody's built that yet. We're hiring the PM who will.




Hey All,




AndPayments is building the next-generation payments stack for Indian businesses — and eventually, for businesses everywhere that need India-grade payments infrastructure. Payments, RegTech, B2B SaaS, Prepaid Instruments — one deliberate stack, built together, not stitched together.

We're hiring a Product Manager – Payment Gateway to solve a problem that's genuinely unsolved in the Indian market.




Here's the gap we're closing:

Payments don't happen in one place anymore. A customer might pay on your website, on your app, at a POS terminal in-store, at a transit gate, or at an EV charging station — often through completely different instruments each time. Most gateway products were built for one of these channels and stretched awkwardly to cover the rest. The result? Fragmented acceptance, inconsistent checkout, and authorization rates that swing wildly depending on where the transaction happens.

Nobody has built a coherent acceptance stack that works consistently from a merchant website to an Android POS to an EV charger. That's the gap this role exists to close.

Card processing — scheme integrations (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), tokenization, EMV 3DS 2.0, passkeys, recurring/mandate architectureThe full omni-channel acceptance layer — website, Android POS, Soundbox, Mobile POS, transit, EV charging, and whatever channel comes nextIntelligent routing & orchestration across acquirers and processors to optimize authorization rates and costChargeback and dispute management, designed for merchant clarity and platform protectionAuthorization rate optimization as a measurable, experiment-driven product outcome — not a hunchFraud monitoring integration, working directly with risk models and decisioning systemsCompliance as a design constraint from day
